clip_research.source_claim: Mark Gurman says there is no real reason to upgrade from an iPhone 17 Pro to an 18 Pro, and Apple is leaning on influencers to drive coverage.
clip_research.public_baseline: Gurman publicly wrote that most iPhone 17 Pro owners shouldn't upgrade to the 18 Pro, and multiple outlets report Apple's influencer-focused event strategy is under scrutiny.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The host's own newsletter and public posts already state the upgrade is minor, so the on-air claim is consistent with his public position rather than a reversal.

evidence.fact: Host says there is no real reason to go from a 17 Pro to an 18 Pro and that Apple calls in influencers.

evidence.fact: Gurman posted that most iPhone 17 Pro owners shouldn't upgrade to the 18 Pro.

evidence.query: Apple influencer takeover events coverage criticism
evidence.fact: Public debate around Apple's influencer flywheel has been reignited.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim Gurman reversed a prior position on the iPhone 18 Pro.
Do not claim Apple has been proven to pay for favorable reviews.
Do not claim Siri AI is confirmed unready for the smart home hub.

notes: Transcript auto-caption 'Mark German' is a mis-transcription of Mark Gurman; corrected in entities.
No reliable Chinese common name found for Vlad Savov; keep English.
Public snippets are leads, not proof; only used where they directly support the label.
